title: Simons engineered Stony Brook joint management of Brookhaven National Lab
place_text: Brookhaven National Laboratory, Long Island, New York

tellings.quote: Stony Brook University was um uh engineered essentially a uh a joint venture essentially to manage Brook Haven National Lab with Vattel Memorial Institute. That partnership was personally engineered by Jim Simons himself

plain: The claim is that a man named Jim Simons personally arranged for Stony Brook University to manage Brookhaven National Laboratory, a government research lab on Long Island, jointly with an organisation called the Battelle Memorial Institute. A researcher named Matthew Pines says this on the show, describing the partnership as "personally engineered by Jim Simons himself", without naming a source. He raises it to suggest that a private figure had a hand in steering a national lab.
